CustomField.description: Total draw prize amount entered when draw is created should be equal to the total amount of all prizes defined.
CustomField.formula: IF (Total_Amount_of_All_Prizes__c = Total_Prize_Fund__c, 'Prize Validation Success ✅' , 'Prize Validation Failed 🔴' )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For successful Validation, the Total Amount of All Prizes should be equal to the Total Prize Fund
CustomField.label: Prize Amount Validation
